organizations.summary_zh: 研究开放世界中的通用操作机器人，强调任务建模、样本高效技能习得、适应与鲁棒执行。

representative_updates.title: Plan to Learn: Active Robot Learning by Planning
representative_updates.summary_zh: 把主动学习、持续学习与规划合并为 Plan-to-Learn 框架，让机器人决定应学习哪些技能及何时请求人类帮助。

organizations.display_name: CMU Interactive and Trustworthy Robotics Lab
organizations.short_name: CMU Interactive and Trustworthy Robotics Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 研究开放世界中可靠交互的具身智能，覆盖不确定性、安全策略、价值对齐与世界建模。

representative_updates.title: From Foresight to Forethought: VLM-In-the-Loop Policy Steering via Latent Alignment
representative_updates.summary_zh: 通过世界模型预测候选动作结果并让 VLM 验证其与任务意图的对齐，在真机上实现运行时策略 steering；发表于 RSS 2025。

organizations.display_name: CMU Learning and Control for Agile Robotics Lab
organizations.short_name: CMU Learning and Control for Agile Robotics Lab
aliases: Learning and Control for Agile Robotics Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 研究学习与控制交叉，重点关注具身智能的敏捷性、可靠性、自适应性与真实系统部署。

representative_updates.title: Flying Hand: End-Effector-Centric Framework for Versatile Aerial Manipulation Teleoperation and Policy Learning
representative_updates.summary_zh: 以末端执行器为中心统一空中操作的遥操作、全身控制与策略学习，并在 RSS 2025 通过同行评审。

organizations.summary_zh: 研究计算机视觉、机器学习与机器人交叉，目标是让智能体从原始感知中持续获得知识并在真实多样环境中泛化。

representative_updates.title: Local Policies Enable Zero-shot Long-horizon Manipulation
representative_updates.summary_zh: 利用局部策略与基础模型组合，将仿真训练迁移到未见过的多阶段真实操作任务，并发表于 ICRA 2025。

organizations.summary_zh: 从视觉输入学习物理与空间表征，并把物理世界的结构与规律用于视觉理解和机器人操作。

representative_updates.title: DemoDiffusion: One-Shot Human Imitation using Pre-trained Diffusion Policy
representative_updates.summary_zh: 从一次人类示范中适配预训练扩散策略，实现跨本体的低样本机器人模仿，并发表于 ICRA 2026。

organizations.display_name: CMU Robots Perceiving and Doing Lab
organizations.short_name: CMU Robots Perceiving and Doing Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 研究机器人感知与控制，使机器人能够在日常杂乱环境中理解变化并完成操作任务。

representative_updates.title: ArticuBot: Learning Universal Articulated Object Manipulation Policy via Large Scale Simulation
representative_updates.summary_zh: 通过大规模仿真训练分层策略，使机器人在真实校园环境中打开未见过的门、抽屉与家电，并发表于 RSS 2025。

organizations.display_name: EPFL Learning Algorithms and Systems Laboratory
organizations.short_name: EPFL Learning Algorithms and Systems Laboratory
organizations.summary_zh: 研究人类示教、灵巧技能、适应性与反应式控制、人机协作及安全，使机器人获得接近人类的操作能力。

representative_updates.title: Imitation-Guided Bimanual Planning for Stable Manipulation under Changing External Forces
representative_updates.summary_zh: 以模仿引导双臂规划，在变化外力下维持稳定操作，连接人类示范、接触鲁棒性与协作控制；发表于 IROS 2025。

organizations.summary_zh: 研究腿足与移动机器人、感知、控制和自主系统，以复杂地形真机部署和鲁棒野外能力见长。

representative_updates.title: A Pragmatist Robot: Learning to Plan Tasks by Experiencing the Real World
representative_updates.summary_zh: PragmaBot 让 VLM 从真机行动结果自我反思并写入长短期记忆，使任务规划逐步适配机器人能力；发表于 RA-L 2026。

organizations.summary_zh: 研究网络化、分布式和协作机器人，同时覆盖机器人计算设计、感知规划控制、可审计学习及人与机器协作。

representative_updates.title: Tiny robot boats that build floating structures
representative_updates.summary_zh: Distributed Robotics Lab 官方组页发布 FloatForm 动态：微型水面机器人以分布式控制协同自组装为可重构浮动结构。

organizations.summary_zh: 研究强化学习、视觉与机器人，强调从物理交互中学习运动、操作和可泛化表征。

representative_updates.title: From Imitation to Refinement -- Residual RL for Precise Assembly
representative_updates.summary_zh: 在冻结的行为克隆扩散策略上训练闭环残差强化学习策略，提高精密对齐和装配可靠性；发表于 ICRA 2025。

organizations.summary_zh: 以动力学、控制理论和机器学习研究敏捷、高效、鲁棒机器人，当前重点转向操作、感知—控制融合与物理推理。

representative_updates.title: Empirical Analysis of Sim-and-Real Cotraining of Diffusion Policies for Planar Pushing from Pixels
representative_updates.summary_zh: 以四十余个真机策略和数百个仿真策略系统分析 sim-and-real 共训练，揭示物理差距、视觉差距和数据规模的作用。

organizations.display_name: Stanford Intelligence through Robotic Interaction at Scale Lab
organizations.short_name: Stanford Intelligence through Robotic Interaction at Scale Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 研究机器人和智能体如何通过大规模学习与交互形成广泛智能行为，覆盖元学习、策略学习与持续适应。

representative_updates.title: Commonsense Reasoning for Legged Robot Adaptation with Vision-Language Models
representative_updates.summary_zh: IRIS 官方代码库发布 VLM-PC，以交互历史和前瞻技能规划让四足机器人在未见障碍中在线选择与重规划行为。

organizations.display_name: Stanford Intelligent and Interactive Autonomous Systems Group
organizations.short_name: Stanford Intelligent and Interactive Autonomous Systems Group
organizations.summary_zh: 研究安全可靠的人机与人—AI交互，关注交互式机器人学习、控制、协调和人类对齐。

representative_updates.title: Robot-Powered Data Flywheels: Deploying Robots in the Wild for Continual Data Collection and Foundation Model Adaptation
representative_updates.summary_zh: 把机器人部署、持续采数和基础模型适配组织成数据飞轮，研究真实场景中的长期迭代闭环。

organizations.display_name: Stanford Interactive Perception and Robot Learning Lab
organizations.short_name: Stanford Interactive Perception and Robot Learning Lab
aliases: Interactive Perception and Robot Learning Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 研究稳健感觉运动协调、交互感知、抓取与操作，连接机器人学习、计算机视觉和多模态接触。

representative_updates.title: Gentle Object Retraction in Dense Clutter Using Multimodal Force Sensing and Imitation Learning
representative_updates.summary_zh: 融合多模态力传感与模仿学习，在密集杂乱场景中完成温和物体牵拉，突出接触安全与力觉反馈。

organizations.summary_zh: 连接计算机动画、机器人、强化学习、物理仿真、最优控制与生物力学，研究动物和机器人协调运动。

representative_updates.title: Hand-Eye Autonomous Delivery: Learning Humanoid Navigation, Locomotion and Reaching
representative_updates.summary_zh: Movement Lab 官方仓库发布 HEAD，将人形机器人的导航、行走与伸手操作联合为手眼协调的长程送达系统。

organizations.display_name: Stanford Robotics and Embodied Artificial Intelligence Lab
organizations.short_name: Stanford Robotics and Embodied Artificial Intelligence Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 通过真实交互、人类示范、仿真和互联网数据研究通用操作、灵巧与全身移动操作。

representative_updates.title: DexUMI: Using Human Hand as the Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Manipulation
representative_updates.summary_zh: 把人手改造为可穿戴通用操作接口，采集视觉、姿态与接触数据并迁移到灵巧机器人手；CoRL 2025 Oral。

aliases: Distributed Collaborative Vision and Exponential Robotics Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 研究协同视觉与机器人、Sim-to-Real、柔性制造和人在环多智能体系统，并强调产业场景验证。

representative_updates.title: DISCOVERSE: Efficient Robot Simulation in Complex High-Fidelity Environments
representative_updates.summary_zh: 发布面向复杂高保真环境的高效机器人仿真平台，支撑标准化 Sim2Real 评测、数据生成和移动操作；发表于 IROS 2025。

aliases: Decision-making Research for Empowered AI Methods Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 研究稳健、可泛化、可部署的数据驱动决策，覆盖强化学习、机器人控制、VLA与真实AIoT系统优化。

representative_updates.title: X-VLA: Soft-Prompted Transformer as Scalable Cross-Embodiment Vision-Language-Action Model
representative_updates.summary_zh: AIR-DREAM 发布轻量跨本体 VLA，以 soft prompt 处理异构机器人数据并开放模型与训练方案。

organizations.summary_zh: 研究深度强化学习、机器人、计算机视觉和触觉，聚焦世界动力学、人类先验、样本效率及真实机器人泛化。

representative_updates.title: DOGlove: Dexterous Manipulation with a Low-Cost Open-Source Haptic Force Feedback Glove
representative_updates.summary_zh: TEA Lab 官方仓库开源低成本力反馈手套、固件和机械设计，用自然遥操作采集接触丰富的灵巧操作示范。

organizations.summary_zh: 以交互世界模型、灵巧控制与感知、具身基础模型为三条主线，连接高层意图与低层物理动作。

representative_updates.title: Dex1B: Learning with 1B Demonstrations for Dexterous Manipulation
representative_updates.summary_zh: 以十亿级仿真示范扩展灵巧操作训练，检验大规模接触数据与真实部署的连接；发表于 RSS 2025。

organizations.display_name: Tsinghua Laboratory of 3D Vision Computing and Machine Intelligence
organizations.short_name: Tsinghua Laboratory of 3D Vision Computing and Machine Intelligence
aliases: Tsinghua 3D Vision Computing and Machine Intelligence Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 研究三维视觉计算与机器智能，重点覆盖动态三维理解、人形机器人学习和人类视频表征。

representative_updates.title: CORE4D: A 4D Human-Object-Human Interaction Dataset for Collaborative Object REarrangement
representative_updates.summary_zh: CORE4D V2 发布真实人—物—人协作重排的四维运动数据，为协作动作预测、合成及机器人交互提供规模化基准。

organizations.summary_zh: 面向通用具身智能，研究把视觉、触觉和力觉等多模态输入映射为操作、人形控制和VLA策略。

representative_updates.title: OneTwoVLA: A Unified Vision-Language-Action Model with Adaptive Reasoning
representative_updates.summary_zh: 在统一 VLA 中按任务难度自适应切换直接动作与显式推理，使快慢决策共享模型和训练流程；发表于 ICLR 2026。

organizations.summary_zh: 研究机器人与自动化中的几何算法、学习、抓取、云机器人和医疗机器人，强调可复现实验与系统。

representative_updates.title: Robot See Robot Do: Imitating Articulated Object Manipulation with Monocular 4D Reconstruction
representative_updates.summary_zh: 利用单目 4D 重建从观察到的机器人视频中恢复铰接物体操作轨迹，并将其转化为真机策略；CoRL 2024 Oral。

organizations.display_name: UC Berkeley Interactive Agents and Collaborative Technologies Lab
organizations.short_name: UC Berkeley Interactive Agents and Collaborative Technologies Lab
aliases: Interactive Agents and Collaborative Technologies Laboratory
organizations.summary_zh: 研究人机与人—AI交互、从人类反馈学习目标、协作决策和对齐，使智能体围绕人的需求行动。

representative_updates.title: Learning to Assist Humans without Inferring Rewards
representative_updates.summary_zh: 研究无需显式推断人类奖励也能学习辅助策略的路径，降低错误人类模型导致的对齐风险；发表于 NeurIPS 2024。

organizations.display_name: UC Berkeley Kanazawa AI Research Lab
organizations.short_name: UC Berkeley Kanazawa AI Research Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 研究从日常图像与视频捕获、感知和理解动态三维世界，并持续学习世界模型。

representative_updates.title: Visual Imitation Enables Contextual Humanoid Control
representative_updates.summary_zh: KAIR 通过 4D 场景重建与人类视频模仿，把视觉理解转成可在上下文环境执行的人形控制；CoRL 2025 最佳学生论文。

organizations.summary_zh: 研究机器人与机器学习，长期覆盖强化、模仿、无监督、迁移与元学习，并重视真实机器人验证。

representative_updates.title: Visual Imitation Enables Contextual Humanoid Control
representative_updates.summary_zh: VideoMimic 从人类视频构建可交互场景与动作监督，训练情境化人形控制策略；获 CoRL 2025 最佳学生论文。

organizations.display_name: UC Berkeley Robotic AI and Learning Lab
organizations.short_name: UC Berkeley Robotic AI and Learning Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 研究可自主学习的灵活与适应性行为，覆盖强化学习、机器人学习、视觉和真实世界策略训练。

representative_updates.title: OGBench: Benchmarking Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
representative_updates.summary_zh: RAIL 发布 OGBench 的多类环境、离线数据集与参考实现，用统一任务检验 stitching、长时序推理及像素控制能力。

organizations.display_name: University of Washington Personal Robotics Lab
organizations.short_name: University of Washington Personal Robotics Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 研究杂乱和不确定环境中与人共处的复杂物理操作，覆盖感知、规划、学习、辅助机器人和交互。

representative_updates.title: ATK: Automatic Task-driven Keypoint Selection for Robust Policy Learning
representative_updates.summary_zh: 自动选择与任务有关的关键点作为策略表征，提高视觉操作策略在遮挡、布局变化和背景变化下的鲁棒性；发表于 CoRL 2025。

organizations.display_name: University of Washington Robot Learning Laboratory
organizations.short_name: University of Washington Robot Learning Laboratory
organizations.summary_zh: 研究机器学习、AI与机器人基础方法，目标是在复杂环境中紧密结合感知、规划、行动与经验改进。

representative_updates.title: Wheeled Lab: Modern Sim2Real for Low-cost, Open-source Wheeled Robotics
representative_updates.summary_zh: 构建低成本、开源的轮式机器人 Sim2Real 研究栈，以统一硬件和训练流程降低真实部署与复现实验门槛。

aliases: Washington Embodied Intelligence and Robotics Development Lab
organizations.summary_zh: 研究家庭真实环境中的机器人操作，并延伸到视觉、语言、人机交互、世界模型、鲁棒性和可靠性。

representative_updates.title: Robometer: Scaling General-Purpose Robotic Reward Models via Trajectory Comparisons
representative_updates.summary_zh: 通过轨迹比较扩展通用机器人奖励模型，使评测与策略改进形成可规模化的反馈环；发表于 RSS 2026。

organizations.summary_zh: 以家庭人形机器人 NEO、通用策略与机器人世界模型为核心的 AI 机器人公司；其 World Model Lab 公开研究以真实视频学习仿真和策略评测，目标是缩短实体测试周期。

representative_updates.title: 1X World Model: Evaluating Bits, not Atoms
representative_updates.summary_zh: 1XWM 从真实机器人数据预测动作条件未来与任务价值，用学习式仿真加速 Redwood/NEO 策略的安全和可靠性评估。

organizations.summary_zh: 智元面向通用具身智能的研究组织，公开使命强调从多样真实经验学习、跨机器人任务环境适配，以及感知—推理—动作闭环；产品、数据平台和规模化部署为研究提供真实场景。官方研究页未公开负责人。

representative_updates.title: AGIBOT’s WITA-Omni Preview Tops Daily-Omni Audio-Visual Reasoning Benchmark
representative_updates.summary_zh: WITA-Omni 以 Thinker–Talker–Actor 架构统一音视频理解、决策、语音、运动和表情生成，作为交互智能模块与操作和运动智能并行演进。

organizations.summary_zh: Amazon 新设的前沿机器人研究组；公开证据主要来自官方招聘，显示其正在建设从机器人软硬件共设计、real2sim2real、灵巧操作和多模态感知到大规模 VLA 的全栈体系。招聘方向属于战略观察，不等同于已发表成果。

representative_updates.title: Member of Technical Staff - Science, Frontier AI & Robotics
representative_updates.summary_zh: 官方岗位明确列出机器人软硬件共设计、灵巧操作、感知、sim-to-real、端到端 VLA 与大模型推理部署；仅作为组织方向证据。

organizations.summary_zh: 以全球超大规模履约机器人集群为真实部署场，研究多机器人协调、移动机器人、触觉操作、人机协作和生产系统中的持续数据闭环；必须与 Amazon FAR 分开跟踪。

representative_updates.title: Amazon builds first foundation model for multirobot coordination
representative_updates.summary_zh: DeepFleet 使用履约中心的海量真实导航数据预训练多机器人交通预测模型，并已用于任务分配与拥堵规避。

organizations.summary_zh: 从高动态控制走向生产级智能机器人的研发和产品组织，Atlas 路线将强化学习、仿真、人类示范、感知、灵巧硬件与大行为模型汇合，并与 RAI Institute 和 Google DeepMind 建立合作；与 RAI 保持独立节点。

representative_updates.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils New Atlas Robot to Revolutionize Industry
representative_updates.summary_zh: 发布生产版 Atlas，强调工业自主任务、快速技能复制、感知安全与电池自换，并宣布与 Google DeepMind 结合 foundation models。

aliases: 字节跳动 Seed 机器人团队
organizations.summary_zh: ByteDance Seed 的通用智能机器人团队，聚焦机器人基础模型、感知、灵巧操作、交互和系统孵化，代表性资产包括 GR-3、GR-RL 与 ByteDexter。官方方向页未设置负责人字段。

representative_updates.title: GR-RL: A Breakthrough in Dexterous Manipulation
representative_updates.summary_zh: GR-RL 通过离线数据过滤、形态对称增强与真机在线强化学习，把鞋带穿孔任务成功率从 45.7% 提升至 83.3%。

organizations.summary_zh: 围绕 Figure 人形本体与 Helix 分层 VLA 联合开发的闭源研究和产品团队，重点追踪全身像素到动作控制、触觉灵巧操作、人类视频迁移、长时家庭任务与工业部署。

representative_updates.title: Introducing Helix 02: Full-Body Autonomy
representative_updates.summary_zh: Helix 02 用统一神经系统从像素控制全身，整合 S0 全身先验、S1 传感到执行与 S2 语义推理，展示四分钟房间尺度 loco-manipulation。

representative_updates.title: Helix: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Generalist Humanoid Control
representative_updates.summary_zh: Figure 首份 Helix 公司技术报告描述 7B S2 语义层与 80M S1 动作层的分层控制；训练与性能数字均为第一方披露。

representative_updates.title: Project Go-Big
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司报告提出利用互联网人类视频扩展机器人视觉与行为知识；尚无开放数据或独立 benchmark 支持。

representative_updates.title: Introducing Index
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司报告将 Index 描述为人类视频数据引擎，并披露 1,600 万视频等规模指标；数据集与评测未开放。

organizations.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 的机器人研究团队以 Gemini Robotics VLA 与 Embodied Reasoning 模型为核心，覆盖跨本体迁移、大小脑协同、全身控制、灵巧操作、多机器人协作和安全评测。官方页面未公开单一团队负责人，避免以博客署名替代组织领导关系。

representative_updates.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
representative_updates.summary_zh: Gemini Robotics 2 同时推进全身 VLA、具身推理高层脑、端侧模型、多机器人协作与 agentic safety。

organizations.summary_zh: Google 体系内面向工业机器人的 Physical AI 平台与研究团队，围绕 Flowstate、Intrinsic Vision Model、开放 ROS/Gazebo 生态、多机器人编排和可重构智能工作单元推进从开发到生产部署。

representative_updates.title: Unlocking the value of Physical AI for manufacturing
representative_updates.summary_zh: 展示 Intrinsic Intelligence Cell：以模块化工作单元、IntrinsicOS、感知、运动规划和抓取技能把 AI 机器人带入电子装配与机床场景。

organizations.summary_zh: Meta FAIR 内与具身智能相关的跨项目研究簇，覆盖视频世界模型、触觉表征与传感硬件、灵巧操作、人机协作、Habitat 导航与开放机器人研究资产。该节点不把所有 Meta affiliation 自动归入同一持久实验室。

representative_updates.title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
representative_updates.summary_zh: 先在超过百万小时互联网视频上自监督学习，再用少量 DROID 机器人视频后训练 latent action 世界模型，并在两地 Franka 机械臂零样本规划。

leaders.name: Ming-Yu Liu
leaders.role: Vice President of Research; lead of Deep Imagination Research

organizations.summary_zh: 面向 Physical AI 的世界基础模型实验室，研究生成式世界仿真、物理推理、具身策略和评测，并持续开放模型、代码与 benchmark。

representative_updates.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
representative_updates.summary_zh: Cosmos 3 将语言、图像、视频、音频与动作统一进 omnimodal 世界模型，并覆盖机器人策略、前向动力学和逆动力学。

organizations.summary_zh: NVIDIA 面向通用具身智能的核心研究组，覆盖多模态基础模型、通用机器人、foundation agents、仿真与合成数据，并以 GR00T、EgoScale 等项目连接人类视频、世界模型与真实机器人策略。

representative_updates.title: EgoScale: Scaling Human Video to Unlock Dexterous Robot Intelligence
representative_updates.summary_zh: 以超过 2 万小时第一视角人类视频预训练灵巧 VLA，并报告人类视频规模与验证损失之间的近似对数线性关系。

organizations.summary_zh: 覆盖感知、任务与运动规划、控制、强化学习、模仿学习、仿真和 VLA 的全栈机器人实验室，重点连接 GPU 加速规划、多模态接触感知与真实机器人部署。

representative_updates.title: NVIDIA Research Advances Robotics From Simulation to the Real World
representative_updates.summary_zh: 以八项 ICRA 工作展示从仿真训练到真实机器人的技术链，覆盖操作、规划、控制与 Sim-to-Real。

organizations.summary_zh: 专注通用机器人基础模型的独立研究公司，以 π 系列 VLA 连接多机器人多任务预训练、开放世界泛化、记忆、实时控制与基于经验的强化学习。官方站未设置可核验的领导岗位页面，因此不从论文作者反推负责人。

representative_updates.title: π0.7: a Steerable Model with Emergent Capabilities
representative_updates.summary_zh: π0.7 将示范、失败与自主数据纳入 steerable 基础模型，强调组合泛化和从部署经验中学习。

organizations.summary_zh: 独立机器人研究院，研究灵巧操作、先进学习控制、机器人交互基础模型、挑战环境导航与机器人社会伦理；与 Boston Dynamics 是合作关系而非同一组织。

representative_updates.title: Whole-Body Model Predictive Control for Spin-Aware Quadrupedal Table Tennis
representative_updates.summary_zh: 在 Spot 四足加机械臂平台上结合连续时间全身 MPC、球旋转估计与击球规划，实现面向人类对打的真机协调控制。

organizations.summary_zh: 以 omni-bodied intelligence 为核心的机器人基础模型公司，利用大规模仿真、互联网人类视频、遥操作与真实部署形成数据飞轮，目标是一套模型控制多种机器人和任务。

representative_updates.title: Introducing S1: In-Context Learning for Robotics
representative_updates.summary_zh: S1 将机器人基础模型构造成 in-context learner，以单段任务视频作为 prompt 执行已见或未见、短时或长时任务，无需额外后训练。

organizations.summary_zh: Tesla 的通用双足人形机器人项目，公开方向覆盖平衡、导航、视觉感知、规划、控制、端侧推理硬件与规模化制造。由于论文和正式实验披露有限，Demo、招聘和投资者材料只能进入部署战略观察层。

representative_updates.title: Digital Optimus
representative_updates.summary_zh: Tesla 官方投资者材料将 Digital Optimus 描述为 AI 开发的下一阶段；该条只证明公司路线与组织投入，不作为同行评审研究成果。

organizations.summary_zh: 围绕老龄社会的人类能力增强开展移动操作、机器人用户体验、原型与研究运营，并以大规模真实 rollouts 严格研究 Large Behavior Models 的数据规模和迁移规律。

representative_updates.title: A Careful Examination of Large Behavior Models for Multitask Dexterous Manipulation
representative_updates.summary_zh: 基于约 1,700 小时训练数据、1,800 次真实 rollout 和超过 47,000 次仿真 rollout，检验 LBM 预训练、微调与数据规模效应。

organizations.summary_zh: Deployment watch centered on Digit's commercial workflows, cooperative safety, uptime, fleet orchestration, and learning from operational data.
information_gaps: Most operational performance and scale figures are company-authored; radar summaries must identify them as such until customer or audited evidence is linked.

representative_updates.title: Digit commercial operations at GXO
representative_updates.summary_zh: Company-authored account of a multi-year commercial deployment; retain separately from research evaluation.

organizations.summary_zh: Deployment watch for Apollo hardware, Robot Park data infrastructure, customer pilots, manufacturing readiness, and Google DeepMind model integration.
information_gaps: Task success, intervention, uptime, and customer-scale claims require work-level or customer-side corroboration before comparative use.

representative_updates.title: Robot Park fleet data collection and customer-site training
representative_updates.summary_zh: Official company announcement of fleet data collection and partner sites; not a peer-reviewed evaluation.

organizations.summary_zh: Early strategic deployment watch connecting world-action models, human-video scaling, dexterous dual-arm workflows, real-time recovery, and production data flywheels.
information_gaps: The first-party pages checked do not name a current executive or research leader; leaders is intentionally empty rather than filled from secondary coverage.
Training data, evaluation protocols, customer identities, intervention rates, and deployment-scale claims need independent or canonical-work corroboration.

representative_updates.title: Production workflows and fleet-learning claims
representative_updates.summary_zh: Company-authored throughput, autonomy, recovery, and deployment claims; do not treat as independently evaluated results.

representative_updates.title: DYNA-2 research release index
representative_updates.summary_zh: Official technical-release index; any future official proceedings record must be linked separately by canonical work.

representative_updates.title: DYNA-1
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司报告在 24 小时餐巾整理运行中报告 850+ 件与 99.4% 成功率；属于内部生产式评测。

representative_updates.title: Open-World Dexterity
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司研究索引日期为 2025-10-15，但正文称 2025 年 12 月；雷达保留该日期冲突，不把它当作精确月度趋势证据。

representative_updates.title: Pre-training Robot Foundation Models on Human Videos
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司报告研究用人类视频预训练机器人基础模型；公开页面不足以支持独立复算。

representative_updates.title: Dyna-2
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司报告以超过 100 万小时第一视角人类视频预训练 Dyna-2，并披露 39 个离线零样本任务及 14 个真机后训练任务；均为内部评测。

representative_updates.title: Dyna-2 Infrastructure
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司基础设施报告披露存储、吞吐与 GPU 利用率改进；这些工程指标来自公司内部，未独立审计。

representative_updates.title: Not Just a Model, But a Product
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司报告 Din Tai Fung 餐厅场景的机器人展开、产能和部署数据回流；吞吐、质量、ROI 与未来机队规模均为公司自报，未同行评审或独立审计。

information_gaps: Performance, safety, and action-count figures are company-authored and require customer-side or canonical-work corroboration before cross-team comparison.
The public research releases are technical disclosures, not official proceedings records.

representative_updates.title: Expanded FedEx autonomous trailer-loading deployment
representative_updates.summary_zh: Joint company announcement of an expanded operating-site deployment; keep separate from peer-reviewed evaluation.

representative_updates.title: Production tactile intelligence evaluation
representative_updates.summary_zh: Company-published production sample and confidence intervals; methodology and claims are not an official peer-reviewed record.

leaders.name: Olivia Norton
leaders.role: Co-Founder and Chief Engineering & Operations Officer

organizations.summary_zh: Closed-source and deployment watch for tactile dexterity, multi-embodiment policies, industrial task reliability, and Phoenix data collection.
information_gaps: Model weights, training data, evaluation protocols, customer identities, and comparable long-duration deployment statistics are limited or proprietary.
Company-stated success rates and production-readiness require independent corroboration.

representative_updates.title: Phoenix generation 8 designed for robot data capture and manufacturing
representative_updates.summary_zh: Product and data-capture announcement; reported capabilities are not an official peer-reviewed evaluation.

organizations.summary_zh: Hardware-and-deployment watch for accessible humanoid and quadruped platforms, whole-body control, dexterous end effectors, datasets, and ecosystem adoption.
information_gaps: The official site mixes product milestones, public performances, competitions, and technical releases; each event must retain its evidence type and cannot be summarized as research validation.

representative_updates.title: G1 and H1 platform milestones and real-world humanoid dataset release
representative_updates.summary_zh: Company-maintained milestone page; product demonstrations, competitions, and dataset announcements remain separate from peer-reviewed evidence.

leaders.name: Ali Farhadi
leaders.role: Ai2 Chief Executive Officer; parent-organization leadership, not asserted as Embodied AI program lead

organizations.summary_zh: Open infrastructure and model ecosystem spanning simulation, 3D assets, navigation, grasping, VLA-style action models, and zero-shot real transfer.
information_gaps: The official Embodied AI page does not designate a single program head; the parent CEO is recorded with a scoped role and must not be treated as a lab-level attribution signal.

representative_updates.title: MolmoSpaces: an open ecosystem for embodied AI
representative_updates.summary_zh: Ai2 officially launched a simulation-first embodied-learning platform combining indoor scenes, object assets, and physics-grounded grasp annotations for navigation, manipulation, controlled evaluation, and zero-shot real transfer research.

organizations.summary_zh: Academic AI umbrella connecting robot learning, control, perception, human interaction, and open humanoid work across several independently tracked Berkeley groups.
information_gaps: The public home page does not expose a complete current leadership roster or uniform publication feed; only the officially documented founding co-director is recorded here.
RAIL, AUTOLAB, InterACT, and other Berkeley labs remain separate attribution targets.

representative_updates.title: Whole-Body Conditioned Egocentric Video Prediction
representative_updates.summary_zh: The official BAIR blog presents PEVA, an action-conditioned egocentric video model using full-body pose trajectories to predict how physical actions change the environment, while explicitly describing closed-loop embodied planning as future work.

aliases: The Robotics Institute at Carnegie Mellon University
organizations.summary_zh: Umbrella institute spanning the complete embodied-intelligence stack; lab-level attribution must remain separate.
information_gaps: Institute-level records must not be counted again when the same canonical work is attributed to LeCAR, Pathak Research Group, or another child lab.

representative_updates.title: Learning Generalizable Robot Skills for Dynamic and Interactive Tasks
representative_updates.summary_zh: The official RI publication page records a CMU-RI technical report on multimodal foundation models, closed-loop policies, embodied memory, and safety-aware robot learning. This is an institute repository attribution to a specific RI work, not a blanket attribution to every RI child lab.

organizations.summary_zh: Broad AI institute with a dense robotics ecosystem, open facilities, and multiple distinct PI groups; child-lab work requires separate attribution.
information_gaps: CSAIL is an umbrella institute; MIT Improbable AI, Robot Locomotion, Distributed Robotics, and other child groups remain independent tracking nodes.

representative_updates.title: Five-year physically intelligent robots initiative
representative_updates.summary_zh: MIT CSAIL officially announced a 2026-2031 program spanning dexterous manipulation, tactile sensing, multimodal perception, AI control, and real-world demonstrations. This is an umbrella-level program update and does not assign resulting work to any single CSAIL child lab.

organizations.summary_zh: Open research platform connecting embodied AI and planning-oriented autonomous driving through models, datasets, benchmarks, challenges, and real-robot collaborations.
information_gaps: Historical Shanghai AI Lab and current HKU relationships require dated affiliation evidence per work; neither parent may be back-propagated across the full history.

representative_updates.title: RISE: Self-Improving Robot Policy with Compositional World Model
representative_updates.summary_zh: OpenDriveLab's official RSS 2026 program page features RISE as a compositional-world-model environment for policy self-improvement in dexterous real-world manipulation. This is a platform-curated project update; individual affiliation remains governed by the author list and dated work evidence rather than the OpenDriveLab domain alone.

organizations.summary_zh: Cross-disciplinary facility and program layer for large-scale real-world robotics projects, not a replacement for Stanford PI-lab attribution.
information_gaps: The center site is project-oriented rather than a complete publication feed; canonical work attribution should normally resolve to participating labs.

representative_updates.title: Optimizing robot teamwork for manufacturing
representative_updates.summary_zh: The SRC official news page highlights an algorithm for jointly planning product subassemblies, individual and team robot work, and collision-aware factory layout, and directly identifies co-author Mac Schwager as SRC faculty. Attribution is limited to the named participating faculty and center-curated work.

organizations.summary_zh: 以大规模跨任务机器人数据训练通才策略的初创公司，研究重点从 GEN-0/GEN-1 的规模化预训练推进到 GEN-1.5 的少样本快速适配。

representative_updates.title: GEN-0
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司报告披露 10B+ 参数通才机器人策略和超过 27 万小时数据的内部扩展结果；未提供同行评审或独立复现。

representative_updates.title: GEN-1
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司报告将数据规模扩展到超过 50 万小时，并报告约一小时任务数据的内部适配实验；性能比例只适用于其自定义任务集。

representative_updates.title: Towards Machines with a Thousand Hands
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司报告研究约 9,000 种生成式末端执行器变化下的跨形态学习；该数字不是 9,000 款实体商业机械手。

representative_updates.title: GEN-1.5
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司报告展示 3–12 秒单次示教与少量梯度更新的快速适配；59%/83% 为内部短任务平均成功率，并非独立 benchmark。

report_metrics.label: 10-step adaptation average success
report_metrics.note: Five minutes of task data; not independently replicated.

organizations.summary_zh: 全栈机器人基础模型初创公司，围绕跨模态数据、仿真、模型与灵巧手硬件协同开发；公司成立前的 Genesis 开源仿真项目不反向计作公司历史成果。

representative_updates.title: GENE-26.5: Advancing Robotic Manipulation to Human Level
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司技术报告披露跨模态数据、分层策略与 20 自由度 Genesis Hand 的系统共设计，并展示长时烹饪任务；所有指标均为公司自报，未经过同行评审或独立复现。

report_metrics.label: cross-modal training data
report_metrics.note: Company self-report; raw evaluation data not open.

representative_updates.title: Genesis World 1.0 and the Path Forward
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司报告发布 Genesis World 1.0 的仿真与 sim-real 相关性结果；代码开放不代表报告中的模型、数据或评测已全部开放，性能数字属于内部评测。

organizations.summary_zh: 家庭机器人初创公司，以无机器人数据预训练与家庭任务适配为核心，ACT 系列报告重点展示衣物折叠等真实双臂操作。

representative_updates.title: ACT-1: Learning Robot Skills with No Robot Data
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司技术报告提出不依赖机器人采集数据的技能预训练路径，并展示真实双臂任务；公开材料不足以支持独立复现。

representative_updates.title: ACT-2 Preview
representative_updates.summary_zh: 公司预览报告在 9 类衣物、785 次内部试验中报告 99.1±0.3% 成功率；范围排除若干衣物类型，标注由公司完成，未独立复现。
